market.session_title: Asia, Europe, and US execution scenarios
market.session.asia.title: Asia session
market.session.asia.body: Use Asia to map the operating range, avoid thin-liquidity overreaction, and prepare invalidation levels before Europe opens.
market.session.asia.check_1: Confirm daily close and early volume quality.
market.session.asia.check_2: Mark range high, range low, and liquidity sweep zones.
market.session.asia.check_3: Avoid chasing until RSI/MACD and structure agree.
market.session.europe.title: Europe session
market.session.europe.focus: Range break, fakeout control, and pre-US flow
market.session.europe.body: Use Europe to detect real breakout versus fakeout while monitoring liquidity rotation before the US session.
market.session.europe.check_1: Check whether price accepts outside the Asia range.
market.session.europe.check_2: Watch BTC.D, ETH.D, TOTAL and USDT.D alignment.
market.session.europe.check_3: Prefer setups with volume expansion and clean EMA structure.
market.session.us.title: US session
market.session.us.focus: ETF flow, macro releases, funding/OI and high-volatility execution
market.session.us.body: Use the US session for ETF/macro validation, futures positioning checks, and stronger confirmation before scaling risk.
market.session.us.check_1: Review ETF flow, FOMC/CPI/PCE/NFP calendar risk.
market.session.us.check_2: Check funding, open interest, and long-short pressure.
market.session.us.check_3: Reduce size if liquidation pressure and news risk are elevated.
